\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 149-152 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:IT-R157-first-pass-words-from-chapters-149-152}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for impossible and necessary.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to celebrate, to fix, to brake, to function, to float
  \item to save oneself, to make a mistake, to exchange, to download, to ski
  \item the brain, a lung, the liver, a kidney, a bone
  \item a medical visit, a diet, rest, sleep, a dream
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To celebrate? (\textbf{festeggiare}.) To fix? (\textbf{fissare}.) To brake? (\textbf{frenare}.) To function? (\textbf{funzionare}.) To float? (\textbf{galleggiare}.) To save oneself? (\textbf{salvarsi}.) To make a mistake? (\textbf{sbagliare}.) To exchange? (\textbf{scambiare}.) To download? (\textbf{scaricare}.) To ski? (\textbf{sciare}.) The brain? (\textbf{il cervello}.) A lung? (\textbf{il polmone}.) The liver? (\textbf{il fegato}.) A kidney? (\textbf{il rene}.) A bone? (\textbf{l'osso}.) A medical visit? (\textbf{la visita}.) A diet? (\textbf{la dieta}.) Rest? (\textbf{il riposo}.) Sleep? (\textbf{il sonno}.) A dream? (\textbf{il sogno}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 153-157 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:IT-R157-second-pass-words-from-chapters-153-157}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for rarely and at once.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item rarely, at once, finally, meanwhile, by now
  \item around, everywhere, nowhere, elsewhere, down there
  \item so, well then, however, instead, anyway
  \item comfortable, uncomfortable, polite, rude, unpleasant
  \item simple, complicated, possible, impossible, necessary
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Rarely? (\textbf{raramente}.) At once? (\textbf{subito}.) Finally? (\textbf{infine}.) Meanwhile? (\textbf{intanto}.) By now? (\textbf{ormai}.) Around? (\textbf{intorno}.) Everywhere? (\textbf{dappertutto}.) Nowhere? (\textbf{da nessuna parte}.) Elsewhere? (\textbf{altrove}.) Down there? (\textbf{laggiù}.) So? (\textbf{quindi}.) Well then? (\textbf{dunque}.) However? (\textbf{però}.) Instead? (\textbf{invece}.) Anyway? (\textbf{comunque}.) Comfortable? (\textbf{comodo}.) Uncomfortable? (\textbf{scomodo}.) Polite? (\textbf{cortese}.) Rude? (\textbf{maleducato}.) Unpleasant? (\textbf{antipatico}.) Simple? (\textbf{semplice}.) Complicated? (\textbf{complicato}.) Possible? (\textbf{possibile}.) Impossible? (\textbf{impossibile}.) Necessary? (\textbf{necessario}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
